set.body:
Requested by a downstream desktop host (eyes4s Studio), stated generically.

Problem
A point batch, where many marks are lowered as one primitive, cannot carry a semantic id or metadata per mark. The host has to keep a side table from batch index to its own key, and that table breaks if lowering reorders, filters or splits the batch. Interaction 01 gives typed identity to grobs, but not to the marks inside a batch.

Scope
Each mark in a batch can carry a semantic id (Interaction 01 identity) and optional small metadata, such as accessible text. Picking over a batch returns the mark's id, and accessibility summaries can name individual marks.

Acceptance criteria
1. Picking a mark in a 10,000-point batch returns its id, including after clipping, filtering and batch splitting.
2. Ids survive lowering on every backend. SVG emits them as data attributes when configured.
3. No per-mark allocation cost when ids are absent (benchmark recorded).
set.title: [Intaglio] Per-mark semantic identity and metadata inside point batches
